title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession
description: Resting-state EEG recorded from 25 patients with Parkinson's disease enrolled in a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of Neuroepo, an EPO formulation with low sialic acid content. Recordings were acquired before and six months after drug or placebo administration (Neuroepo n=15, placebo n=10). The raw data are shared in EEG-BIDS format to support evaluation of neuroprotective effects and qEEG biomarkers of disease progression.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded before and six months after administration of Neuroepo or placebo. Two experts rated EEG abnormalities on a Likert-type scale, analyzed with a multivariate item response theory approach. Quantitative EEG source analysis used VARETA with co-registration to the MNI atlas. Group and time comparisons used permutation tests and surfstat contrasts with Bonferroni correction.
